channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Twelve Palestine Action activists granted bail
item.description: Bailed activists include four former hunger strikers: Teuta Hoxha, Kamran Ahmed, Qesser Zuhrah and Heba Muraisi.

item.title: US envoy suggests it would be ‘fine’ if Israel expands across Middle East
item.description: 'It would be fine if they took it all,' Mike Huckabee says when asked about expanding Israel from Nile to Euphrates.

item.title: US military says it attacked vessel in Pacific Ocean, killing three people
item.description: US military's Southern Command (SOUTHCOM) claimed the vessel was involved in drug trafficking, without providing proof.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,458
item.description: These are the key developments from day 1,458 of Russia's war on Ukraine.

item.title: Trump, JD Vance vilify ‘lawless’ Supreme Court justices over tariff ruling
item.description: President Trump calls Supreme Court justices an 'embarrassment to their families' in 45-minute address to media.

item.title: Gunmen on motorcycles kill at least 50 in northwest Nigeria: Report
item.description: Nigerian lawmaker reports ‘at least 50 people dead’ after attack as list of missing is still being compiled.

item.title: Brazil’s Lula says Maduro should face trial in Venezuela, not US
item.description: Brazil's President Lula says fate of Venezuelan president should be determined by the 'people of Venezuela'.

item.title: Where are the most endangered languages in the world?
item.description: February 21 is World Mother Language Day. Al Jazeera looks at the most spoken languages and which ones are endangered.

item.title: UK weighs removing ex-Prince Andrew from succession line amid Epstein probe
item.description: The report comes as police widen investigations into former prince, including questioning his close protection teams.

item.title: Clashes in Albania as protesters demand PM Rama resign
item.description: Violence breaks out near parliament as demonstrators demand accountability in a corruption investigation.
